data: What is the approximate k-NN accuracy of the green line in the 'WEB OF SCIENCE' plot at 200 #Topics?

The question asks for the approximate k-NN accuracy of the green line in the 'WEB OF SCIENCE' plot at 200 #Topics. From the caption, we know that the green line represents the Inverse multiquadric kernel. The figure shows four subplots labeled a) REUTERS, b) 20 NEWSGROUPS, c) WEB OF SCIENCE, and d) ARXIV. The relevant subfigure is c) WEB OF SCIENCE.

In this subfigure, the green line (Inverse multiquadric kernel) appears to be the lowest among the three lines. At approximately 200 #Topics, the green line is around 0.85 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate k-NN accuracy of the green line in the 'WEB OF SCIENCE' plot at 200 #Topics is 0.85.
